detail_totals.schedule: Schedule M - General Fund Operational Expenses

notes: Modified cash basis, all funds governmental (School Nutrition and Activities are governmental funds here); no business-type funds. Receipts/disbursements from Exhibit III Total Governmental Funds column (labels p4/p6, amounts p5/p7); beginning/ending balances p9 (10,992,349.50 and 33,334,957.51, equal to net position on p1). Statement lines Local Receipts, County Receipts, State Receipts and Non-Revenue Receipts are split using the fund schedules (A, C, D, F, G, H, I); split items tie to the printed lines. Non-Revenue Receipts 30,608,073.18 = Issuance of Bonds 30,055,000 (debt_proceeds, p19) + allocations from General Fund 500,000 and 30,290.51 (in transfers_in) + other non-revenue 22,782.67 (receipt, review). transfers_in 631,290.51 = 101,000 printed transfers + 530,290.51 allocations; transfers_out 101,000 (General Fund to Lunch 70,000, Bond 1,000, Activities 30,000, all matched in receiving funds). The 530,290.51 allocations have no matching outflow in the General Fund (see decision_needed). reported_totals use the printed Total Receipts and Other Financing Sources 44,465,862.34 (p5; includes debt_proceeds and transfers_in) and Total Disbursements and Other Financing Uses 22,123,254.33 (p7; includes transfers_out). Disbursement function mapping: State Categorical Programs (career education) and Federal Programs (Title I, ESSER) to instruction; Employee Benefits line (Employee Benefit Fund) support services with review; Other Purchased Services and Supplies (special building construction) capital outlay; Debt Service all interest/fees per Schedule H (no principal paid). Detail: Schedule M (General Fund operational expenses by program and object) supersedes Schedule B (function-only), so Schedule B and A-1 (summary) are not recorded to avoid double counting; Schedule M lines with no actual amount are omitted; transfers 8000 recorded as negative other financing. Fund schedules C-I record 5200 allocations/transfers and bond issuance as other financing (printed inside the schedule receipts totals, marked includes). Schedule N (county treasurers' schedule, pp27-28) is a pass-through of General Fund receipts and is not recorded. Object mapping: Other Property Services to professional/contract services, Purchased Property Services to repairs and maintenance, Property to equipment purchases. Balance sheet from Exhibit I (p1): cash and deposits plus county treasurers' balance, no liabilities. Read pages 1-28 of 28
